correctness.rationale: Confirmed X6 is join of ten complementary S0 factors and hence S9. The star-cluster of the simplex of triples containing 7 is contractible in the flag complex X7. The least-available-point concentration map is a simplicial retraction to X6, so L→X6 factors through contractible U and is nullhomotopic; X7≃S9∨ΣL. Independently enumerated all 3^10 complementary-pair selections with the 15 two-point transversal tests, giving 54,870 nonempty L faces and the full f-vector. Verified acyclicity on all 358,760 directed Hasse covers of a 27,398-pair Morse matching; 74 critical cells remain (0:1,5:42,6:19,7:6,8:6). Reconstructed integer Morse boundaries using oriented gradient elimination, with unimodular unit-only ranks 13 for d6, 6 for d7 and zero d8; chain products zero. This proves H~5(L)=Z^29,H~8(L)=Z^6 with no torsion and 4-connectivity, hence X7 5-connected with H~6=Z^29,H~9=Z^7 and no other homology. Mod-2/rational evidence alone would not exclude odd torsion.
residual_risks: The Morse chain contraction has been checked by exact integer unit operations on 54,870 faces, not a hand symbolic Smith form.
Rational/F2 comparisons alone would miss odd-primary torsion; the exact integer certificate is essential.

value.rationale: An explicitly published integral torsion question remains open despite known rational and mod-two ranks. The k=1 case is the first nontrivial triple-Kneser parameter, naturally motivated, and its complete integer computation eliminates the previously undetectable odd-primary possibility and establishes 5-connectivity. This is a substantive exact benchmark with possible use in future global torsion analyses, not a table recomputation.
residual_risks: Only first nontrivial Kneser triple parameter; future all-parameter torsion question remains open.

limitations: Does not settle Feng Question 19 for all k.
